title: Giving Old Waste Bins a Second Life
description: As the City of San Diego rolls out new gray trash bins to more than 225,000 households eligible for City trash service, you may wonder what happens to the old black trash bins being taken away. Thanks to a collaboration with bin manufacturer Rehrig Pacific Company, the old trash bins (and soon the old blue recycling bins) are being recycled and given a second life. Recycling of the old bins began in mid-October 2025. When the process is complete, which is expected to be late summer 2026, the City and Rehrig Pacific will have recycled more than 750,000 trash and recycling bins!
